crumb: Breadcrumb in the header linking back to the Schedules page.
crumb-schedule: Breadcrumb in the header for one schedule's page.
deleted-socio: Stands in for a socio's name when that socio (an AI agent; product noun) was deleted.

goal-status.active: Badge for the status of a goal a socio works toward for the person.
goal-status.paused: Badge for the status of a goal a socio works toward for the person.
goal-status.done: Badge for the status of a goal a socio works toward for the person.
goal-status.cancelled: Badge for the status of a goal a socio works toward for the person.
interval.week: How often a task made in a conversation repeats; the next run comes only after a successful one. Starts a cell or a line, so capitalized.
interval.day: How often a task made in a conversation repeats; the next run comes only after a successful one. Starts a cell or a line, so capitalized.
interval.hour: How often a task made in a conversation repeats; the next run comes only after a successful one. Starts a cell or a line, so capitalized.
interval.hours: How often a task made in a conversation repeats; the next run comes only after a successful one. Starts a cell or a line, so capitalized.
interval.minutes: How often a task made in a conversation repeats; the next run comes only after a successful one. Starts a cell or a line, so capitalized.
actions.run: Button or menu item: run the schedule (or job) now, outside its cadence.
actions.pause: Button or menu item: pause a schedule; it keeps its cadence.
actions.resume: Button or menu item: resume a paused schedule.
actions.load-more: Button under a list of runs that loads older ones.
actions.change-failed: Error toast when pausing, resuming, running or canceling a schedule failed.
actions.older-failed: Error toast when older runs could not be loaded.
no-runs: Shown instead of the runs list when there are none.
comments.count: Toggle that shows a goal's comments; the count of comments the person and the socio added.
comments.you: Author of a comment the person wrote themselves, before its time.
comments.none: Shown when a goal has no comments.
comments.label: Accessible name of the box to type a comment on a goal.
comments.placeholder: Placeholder in the comment box; {{name}} is the socio's name (an AI agent).
comments.failed: Error toast when the comment could not be posted.
